name: astroledger-root
description: AstroLedger — Vedic Astrology Client & Practice Management System

scripts.test:backend: cd backend && python manage.py test apps.accounts apps.clients apps.consultations apps.dashboard apps.sync apps.core
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && cd desktop && npm run build:all && npm run pack:win
scripts.pack:desktop:dir: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && cd desktop && npm run build:all && npm run pack:dir
scripts.mobile:setup: npm run build:frontend && cd mobile && npm install && npx cap add android
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:frontend && cd mobile && npx cap sync
scripts.build:apk: npm run icons:android && npm run build:frontend && cd mobile && npx cap sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:open: cd mobile && npx cap open android
